# openinfra_training_job (Data Source)

Read an existing `kind: TrainingJob`. `spec` and `status` are returned as JSON strings so this stays correct as the platform adds fields — decode them with `jsondecode()`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the resource to read.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace to read from. Defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name` identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource reports a Ready condition of True.
- `spec` (String) The resource's `spec`, JSON-encoded.
- `status` (String) The resource's `status`, JSON-encoded (empty object if absent).
